meta.note: Career totals cover the staged IE cycles (2022+2024+2026) ONLY. No IE files are staged for earlier cycles; these are not full-career totals. All-IE columns are separate from total_accepted and are never blended into it.
filter_rules: dedup by (spe_id, tran_id): keep latest receipt_dat, tie-break highest file_num; blank tran_id never deduped against another row
registered committee only: spe_id in same-cycle work/bulk/cm/<cycle>/cm.txt
identified candidate only: non-blank cand_id in any staged weball file (1980-2026) OR a roster FEC candidate ID; blank cand_id rows excluded from published totals
support and oppose summed separately, never netted; blank sup_opp rows count in total only

form_type_double_count_check.finding: No form-type column exists in the bulk IE files, so F24/F3X cannot be separated by form. The bulk file carries ONE copy per expenditure (the notice copy; pull-log-b §7 verified file_num/image_num match the F24 filing), and (spe_id, tran_id) dedup removes any same-transaction repeat. Proof: UDP 2024 deduped S+O reproduces the tracker total $38,044,932.69 to the cent — a file that double-counted across form types would be ~2x. Near-duplicate rows (same committee/candidate/date/amount/direction, different tran_id AND different image_num = different filings) are treated as separate expenditures and quantified per cycle in exclusions[].

coverage.earlier_cycles_available: Per the FEC independent-expenditures file description (fetched Nov 12, 2026), historical data is available beginning with the 2010 cycle, and the FEC bulk-data index publishes independent_expenditure_YYYY.csv per cycle. Files for 2010/2012/2014/2016/2018/2020 exist and are NOT staged here (each ~14-19 MB, same format) — expanding to them is a follow-up, not done in this pull. Pre-2010 cycles have no such file.
